hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.intro: How Wings Hub handles the details you send us.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: If you use the contact form, we receive the name, email address, optional phone number and message you type in. We do not ask for anything else.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use these details only to reply to your message. We keep a message only as long as we need it to reply.

sections.heading: Who handles it
paragraphs: The contact form is handled by our website host, Cloudflare, which also runs a security check to stop automated spam. The message is then emailed to us through the email service Brevo.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: Maps and other websites
paragraphs: The map on our pages is provided by Google Maps. When it loads, Google may collect information under its own privacy policy. Links to other websites, such as delivery apps, are covered by those sites' own policies.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: To see, correct or delete the details you sent us, email us at the address below.
